sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.
This Court has issued notice of Rule to opponent who is duly served but though served, no one appears for the opponent despite being given sufficient opportunity.

2. This application filed under Section 24 of Civil Procedure Code, 1908 (CPC) by the applicant-wife is seeking transfer of Family Suit No.603 of 2024 filed by opponent pending before the Family Court at Rajkot, to the Family Court at Modasa, District Arvalli.

entities.text: Family Court at Modasa, District Arvalli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. The opponent - husband of applicant has chosen to file a Family Suit No.603 of 2024 before the Family Court at Rajkot against the applicant under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

An averment is made in the application that the NEUTRAL CITATION C/MCA/1564/2025 ORDER DATED: 26/09/2025 undefined applicant happens to be wife of opponent, who is residing at Modasa, whereas the opponent has instituted the Family Suit at Rajkot, which is around 330 Kms away from her place of residence.

sentences.text: A further averment surfaces that there are multiple proceedings instituted against opponent either be it under Domestic Violence Act and/ or Registration of FIR against opponent under Section 498A of IPC, which are pending before the Competent Court at Modasa.

She would further submit that there is an order passed by the Family Court, Modasa on 20 th March, 2025 directing opponent to pay the applicant a monthly maintenance of Rs.10,000/-, but at this stage, he is not in a position to make any positive statement about compliance of such order by opponent and therefore,
the prayer has been made as referred hereinabove.
4. At this stage, it would be fruitful to refer to the ratio laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the cases of :- (i) Smita Singh Versus Kumar Sanjay reported in AIR 2002 SC 396 and (ii) N.C.V.
Aishwarya versus A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1199 : 2022 LiveLaw (SC)
5.

sentences.text:
Considering the averments made in the application and NEUTRAL CITATION C/MCA/1564/2025 ORDER DATED: 26/09/2025 undefined on perusing the material on record,
the applicant has not substantial income and it appears that there are multiple proceedings instituted against opponent either be it under Domestic Violence Act and/ or Registration of FIR against opponent under Section 498A of IPC, which are pending before the Competent Court at Modasa.
Furthermore, the distance between Rajkot to Modasa is around 330 kms.

In addition, as stated hereinabove, though notice of Rule has been served upon the opponent-husband, there is no representation from his side and therefore, the averments made in the present application remain uncontroverted.
6.

Thus, considering overall facts and circumstances of the case as also keeping in mind the inconvenience that may cause to the applicant vis--vis the opponent which is much higher, this Court is inclined to exercise discretion in favour of the applicant.
7. In the backdrop as aforesaid, present application succeeds and is allowed accordingly.
Consequently, Family Suit No.603 of 2024 pending before the Family Court at Rajkot is ordered to be transferred to the Family Court at Modasa, District Arvalli.

sentences.text: 8. It is also open for the opponent to request the concerned Family Court to allow him to join the proceedings through NEUTRAL CITATION C/MCA/1564/2025 ORDER DATED: 26/09/2025 undefined video conferencing / online mode and if such a request is made by the opponent, the Family Court may consider the same unless the physical presence of the opponent is required to attend the proceedings at a particular stage of proceedings.
9. Rule is made absolute.
Accordingly, application is disposed of.
